$comment: DEVAI-native (Phase 17.G): stack-adapter pack manifest. Composes through the --seeds plumbing (Phase 11) and the law-pack precedent (Phase 10.K, D-53). Per D-57.
title: Stack Adapter Pack Manifest
description: Manifest record at the root of a stack-adapter pack (e.g. examples/redox-pack-nestjs-postgres-react/stack-adapter.json). Declares detection heuristics, inventory-sensor parameter overrides, writer-skill prompt overlays, and seed invariants. Loaded by the seed-merge plumbing (Phase 11) when the adopter passes `--seeds <path>` or when auto-detection picks the pack. Per Constitution Article 6 (authority); per D-57 (brownfield-adoption substrate); per D-53 (examples/ is integral to DEVAI).

id.description: Pack id (kebab-case). Prefix 'redox-pack-' is the canonical convention for packs absorbed from / inspired by redox's stack-adapter taxonomy; non-redox-derived packs MAY use a different prefix once the prefix taxonomy is formalized (deferred).

stack.description: Triple naming the (backend, frontend, db) the pack targets. Used by the detector and by writer prompt overlays.

detect.description: Heuristics that mark a repo as matching this stack. Detection MAY combine signals; the pack matches when ANY of `signals[]` matches (OR semantics). Phase 17.G ships only filesystem-presence + package.json-dep signals; future signals (composer.json deps, Gemfile, go.mod) ride the same shape.

priority.description: When multiple packs match the same repo, the highest-priority pack wins. Ties surface as a scorecard ambiguity and defer to Architect (Article 19).

extractor_params.description: Per-sensor parameter overrides. Each key is an inventory sensor kind (inventory_api / inventory_routes / inventory_data_model / inventory_rbac / inventory_data_handling / inventory_dep_graph / inventory_coverage); each value is an opaque parameter object passed to the sensor at run time. Sensor adapters that read these fields validate them per-sensor (this schema does not constrain the shape).

prompt_overlays.description: Per-writer-skill prompt-component appendages. Each key is a SKILL-write-* id; each value is an array of additional PromptComponentInput records that the writer composes onto the default writer composition (global + role + task? + payload + overlay). Each overlay item carries an optional `mode`: `append` (default) adds the component; `replace_layer` replaces the writer's own namespaced component for that layer (the `${skill_id}.${layer}` entry) — shared components like `writer.output-contract` and per-writer word-budget survive. The `replace_layer` form lets server-rendered packs (e.g. Laravel-Blade) override stack-incompatible guidance baked into the default global, rather than only appending to it (P3.10).

name.description: Slug identifier for the component. Convention: <pack-id>.<short-purpose> (e.g. 'redox-pack-nestjs-postgres-react.api-map'). Enforced as a kebab/dot slug so typos and free-text names surface at schema-validate time (P3.12).

body.description: Component body, in plain text. Capped at 4000 chars so a pack cannot silently bloat the writer prompt past the per-writer budget. Compose multiple overlay items if more is genuinely needed.

mode.description: P3.10: `append` (default) appends the component alongside the writer's own; `replace_layer` removes the writer's namespaced contribution for `layer` (the `${skill_id}.${layer}` component) before appending. Shared components (writer.output-contract, ${skill_id}.word-budget) survive regardless. Use `replace_layer` only when the writer's default global is structurally wrong for the stack (e.g. 'group endpoints by controller class' is wrong for a Laravel-Blade web monolith).

templates.description: Per-stack template registry consumed by SKILL-scaffold-* (Phase 18.F). Each key is a template id (kebab/dot slug, e.g. 'db.migration', 'api.controller'); each value declares the relative path under the pack directory and the consumer scaffolder skill id. Empty / absent = pack provides no scaffolding for this stack (manual scaffolding required). Templates are token-bearing source files (`__NAMESPACE__`, `__MODULE__`, `__kebabEntity__`, etc.) consumed by the deterministic template engine in packages/core/src/templates/. Per D-59 18.C.

path.description: Relative path from the pack directory to the template file (e.g. 'templates/db/migration.sql.tpl').

consumed_by.description: Producer-consumer link: which Phase-18 scaffolder skill consumes this template.

seed_invariants.description: Relative paths (from this manifest) to INV-CLIENT-*.json files the pack seeds. Each must validate against invariant.schema.json when copied into the adopter's law/invariants/.

path.description: Relative path under the adopter repo root. Required for file_present + dir_present.

weight.description: Optional weight (future: weighted-OR detection). Phase 17.G uses OR semantics regardless.
